records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero engagement: no reply to three outbound emails (email:f5c9f136, email:c57d99c6, email:8c10f312), no tickets, no first project, no invites sent. Starter plan, no signal of intent or a champion, so an unprompted activation in the remaining 8 days looks unlikely.

draft.subject: Help getting your first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

I wanted to follow up on my note from yesterday. Nothing has kicked off in your Wrenfield workspace yet, and I'd rather not let the first week slip by without you seeing what it can do.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the quickest way to get oriented. If it's useful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week work? I'll walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
